hook.en: A variable is like a label stuck on a value in memory. The value might be a whole number, a decimal, some text or a list. Python must know which kind it is. How?
hook.kn: ಚರ ಎಂದರೆ ಸ್ಮರಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಮೌಲ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಅಂಟಿಸಿದ ಹೆಸರುಪಟ್ಟಿ. ಮೌಲ್ಯ ಪೂರ್ಣಾಂಕ, ದಶಮಾಂಶ, ಪಠ್ಯ ಅಥವಾ ಪಟ್ಟಿ ಆಗಿರಬಹುದು. ಅದು ಯಾವ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಎಂದು ಪೈಥಾನ್‌ಗೆ ಹೇಗೆ ಗೊತ್ತಾಗುತ್ತದೆ?

objectives.en: Classify Python data types and identify mutable and immutable types

narration.en: A variable is like a label stuck on a value in memory. The value might be a whole number, a decimal, some text or a list. Python must know which kind it is. How?
narration.kn: ಚರ ಎಂದರೆ ಸ್ಮರಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಮೌಲ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಅಂಟಿಸಿದ ಹೆಸರುಪಟ್ಟಿ. ಮೌಲ್ಯ ಪೂರ್ಣಾಂಕ, ದಶಮಾಂಶ, ಪಠ್ಯ ಅಥವಾ ಪಟ್ಟಿ ಆಗಿರಬಹುದು. ಅದು ಯಾವ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಎಂದು ಪೈಥಾನ್‌ಗೆ ಹೇಗೆ ಗೊತ್ತಾಗುತ್ತದೆ?

body.en: A variable is a name that refers to a value stored in memory. It is created when we assign a value with =, for example marks = 85. Python decides the type from the value, and the same variable can later refer to a value of another type. A comment begins with # and is ignored by the interpreter; it explains the code to human readers. In Python everything is an object: each object has a unique identity, which id() returns, a type and a value.

points.en: Comments start with # and are not executed
Every object has an identity (id), a type and a value

narration.en: A variable is a name that refers to a value stored in memory. It is created when we assign a value with =, for example marks = 85. Python decides the type from the value, and the same variable can later refer to a value of another type. A comment begins with # and is ignored by the interpreter; it explains the code to human readers. In Python everything is an object: each object has a unique identity, which id() returns, a type and a value.
narration.kn: ಚರ ಎಂದರೆ ಸ್ಮರಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಮೌಲ್ಯವನ್ನು ಸೂಚಿಸುವ ಹೆಸರು; = ಬಳಸಿ ಮೌಲ್ಯ ನೀಡಿದಾಗ ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. # ನಿಂದ ಆರಂಭವಾಗುವ ಟಿಪ್ಪಣಿಯನ್ನು ಇಂಟರ್‌ಪ್ರಿಟರ್ ಕಡೆಗಣಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಪೈಥಾನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲವೂ ವಸ್ತು (object); ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದಕ್ಕೂ id(), ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಮತ್ತು ಮೌಲ್ಯ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: On the board: Variables are names that point to values

say.en: marks equals 85 creates an int object 85 and makes the name marks refer to it.
name equals Asha in quotes makes a string object.
If we now write marks equals 92.5, the name simply points to a new float object. Python decides the type from the value.
Python’s data types fall into these groups.
Some types can be changed after creation; others cannot.

narration.en: We draw names and the objects they refer to in memory, then sort Python’s data types.

prompt.en: Which family does each Python value belong to?
prompt.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ Python ಮೌಲ್ಯ ಯಾವ ಕುಟುಂಬಕ್ಕೆ ಸೇರಿದೆ?

explanation.en: int, float and complex are numbers, and bool (True/False) is a subtype of int. Strings, lists and tuples are sequences. A dict maps keys to values. {1, 2, 3} is a set and None means no value.
explanation.kn: int, float, complex ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಗಳು; bool int ನ ಉಪಪ್ರಕಾರ. str, list, tuple ಅನುಕ್ರಮಗಳು. dict ಮ್ಯಾಪಿಂಗ್. {1, 2, 3} ಸೆಟ್.

body.en: Numbers: int (whole numbers such as −5 and 42), float (real numbers such as 3.14) and complex (such as 2 + 3j). bool has only True and False and is a subtype of int. Sequences: str (text in quotes), list (items in square brackets) and tuple (items in round brackets). A set holds unordered unique items in curly braces. None means no value. A dict (dictionary) maps keys to values. Lists, sets and dictionaries are mutable (their contents can change); int, float, complex, bool, str and tuple are immutable.

points.en: Numbers: int, float, complex; bool ⊂ int
Mutable: list, set, dict. Immutable: int, float, complex, bool, str, tuple

narration.en: Numbers: int (whole numbers such as −5 and 42), float (real numbers such as 3.14) and complex (such as 2 + 3j). bool has only True and False and is a subtype of int. Sequences: str (text in quotes), list (items in square brackets) and tuple (items in round brackets). A set holds unordered unique items in curly braces. None means no value. A dict (dictionary) maps keys to values. Lists, sets and dictionaries are mutable (their contents can change); int, float, complex, bool, str and tuple are immutable.
narration.kn: ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಗಳು: int, float, complex; bool (True/False). ಅನುಕ್ರಮಗಳು: str, list, tuple. set, None ಮತ್ತು dict ಇತರ ಪ್ರಕಾರಗಳು. list, set, dict ಬದಲಾಯಿಸಬಹುದಾದವು (mutable); int, float, str, tuple ಬದಲಾಯಿಸಲಾಗದವು (immutable).
